description: This source file defines the `LakeraAIGuardrail` class for integrating Lakera AI v2 guardrail functionality into a larger system. It includes methods for making API calls, masking PII, handling guardrail violations, and hooks for pre-call and during-call processing within a FastAPI-based or similar framework.
